(1) Hierarchy per owner decision: rows and headings same size (13 px); heading of the section on screen bold in NORMAL text colour, never coloured, in Plain and Color; icons keep colour when Color is on; no row ever bold; rows at rest dim (--muted); hovered, keyboard-focused and open rows (both split panes) full text colour; no width jump. Update the AGENTS.md sidebar bullet (owner approved) and tests. (2) Resize handles (RESEARCH section 3): no line or colour on pointer hover or drag, only the cursor; keyboard focus stays visible. (3) Floating (RESEARCH section 4): no painted resize edge; list hugs its content if possible without changing jointFit/floating.ts or the overlap guarantee, else block and say so. Acceptance: tsc, npm test, specs sidebar-selection, floating, hover-emphasis, layout, split-view, alignment; light/dark Plain/Color screenshots read.
